{"consolidated_memory":"TRUNCATED DOCUMENTS IN search/indexer/chunker.ts — THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

This is a recurring class of issue in the same component with the same symptom but three distinct root causes, triggers, and fixes across different dates.

COMMON CHARACTERISTICS:
- Component: search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
- Problem: truncated documents in the chunker
- Repro method: index the long changelog fixture
- Signal: chunk offsets that stop short of the document length

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-29]
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Measured outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 75 days running
- Fix: switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #3172 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1

OCCASION 2: [2026-03-06]
- Trigger: occurred only after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Measured outcome: reclaimed 99 GB of blob storage
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #3677 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2

OCCASION 3: [2026-08-11]
- Trigger: occurred only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Measured outcome: alert stayed quiet for 35 consecutive days
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #5870 on branch fix/truncated-documents-3

NOTE: Same corner of search/indexer/chunker.ts across all three incidents; context carried over from prior truncated documents work."}
